verdict.rationale: Databricks' first-party notebooks support multiple languages with built-in data visualizations for presenting results (docs-12, docs-37). A getting-started tutorial queries Unity Catalog data and visualizes the results directly in the notebook (docs-23), and a community user praises the integrated visualizations (comm-9). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that SQL and Python can be mixed cell-by-cell in one notebook, and explicit evidence of running notebooks against SQL warehouse compute rather than just Unity Catalog tables.
